text:
We are an award winning architectural and interior design firm located in the Flatiron District of Manhattan specializing in residential, lifestyle hospitality, and education projects. Our residential work varies from affordable housing to highly detailed residences and luxury high rises. Our hospitality portfolio ranges from intimate boutique properties to large urban resorts. We are looking for multi-talented individuals with a minimum of a BArch from a U.S. accredited school to join our growing mid-size architectural firm. Positions offer a chance to be part of a team environment with exposure to award winning design, an exceptional client base, and a record of over 50 years of successfully completed projects.
Position:
Architect: We are seeking talented energetic, creative, self-starter with intermediate level of industry experience.
Responsibilities:
Work directly with senior architects and interior designers to prepare digital presentations and contract documents throughout concept design, schematic design and design development to construction phases.
Qualifications:
Salary range $75,000 - $110,000.
